rules: Headings must use tight letter spacing (tracking-tighter).
Avoid pure centering for headings unless specific for symmetric hero layouts. Prefer left-aligned typographic blocks.
Line height must be relaxed for body text (leading-relaxed).
Overlines should be uppercase with wide tracking.
Use #F5F5F5 for alternating sections to create subtle depth.
Red accent (#E53935) should be used sparingly for high-impact buttons, active states, and typographic highlights.
Ensure text on red background is pure white.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-black/10 for structural grids and cards. Use border-collapse for bento grid layouts.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on the hero section background to break digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal shadows. Rely on solid borders and background color shifts for depth. If needed, use sharp, offset solid shadows (neo-brutalist) instead of soft blurs.
visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-none or minimal rounded-sm (2px) to maintain an industrial/corporate vendor aesthetic.
visual_enhancers.overlays: Hero images must have a calculated overlay to ensure text contrast. Use bg-black/40.

component_name.buttons: Sharp-edged (rounded-none), high-contrast. Primary: bg-[#E53935] text-white hover:bg-[#D32F2F] transition-colors. Secondary: border border-[#111111] text-[#111111] hover:bg-[#111111] hover:text-white.
component_name.cards: Flat design with 1px border. Image on top (clipped frame with object-cover), content below with generous padding (p-6 or p-8).
component_name.navigation: Sticky glassmorphism header (bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-black/5). Left-aligned logo, right-aligned links and CTA.
component_name.inputs: Shadcn UI inputs customized to have square corners (rounded-none), border-black/20, focus:border-[#E53935] focus:ring-0.

grids.bento_strategy: Use asymmetric grids for the Services and Infrastructure sections. e.g., A 12-column grid where items span 4, 8, or 6 columns to create a dynamic masonry feel.
grids.spacing: Generous spacing. Use gap-6 to gap-12 between grid items. Section padding should be py-24 to py-32.

Home.Hero: Kinetic typography reveal. Large h1 text ('Executing Visions, Printing Reality'). Subtle 3D or parallax image block behind or alongside text.
Home.Client Marquee: Slow, smooth-scrolling logo strip (using react-fast-marquee). High contrast, greyscale logos.
Home.Services Grid: 6 core offerings in an asymmetric bento grid. Each card features real product photography (spotlight treated).
Home.Manifesto: Numbered chapters (01. Precision, 02. Scale, etc.) set in large display font, alternating left/right alignment.
Home.Infrastructure Teaser: Side-by-side layout: Large typography on one side, masked/clipped image of a printing machine on the other.
Home.Contact CTA: Dark or red section block, bold header, leading to contact page.

layouts.About: Focus on the company's vendor history. Large typography, timeline of growth, team/infrastructure imagery.
layouts.Services: Detailed list of services with larger spotlight images and specifications.
layouts.Portfolio: Masonry gallery of case studies. Real retail project imagery. Hover reveals project name.
layouts.Infrastructure: Technical specifications of machines (Latex, Solvent, UV). Minimalist layout with sharp technical aesthetic.
layouts.Contact: Split layout. Left: Contact info (WhatsApp, Call, Address). Right: Quote enquiry form. WhatsApp/Call floating action buttons fixed to bottom right.

motion.scrolling: Implement @studio-freight/lenis for smooth momentum scrolling across the entire site.
motion.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line reveal using framer-motion. Wrap lines in overflow-hidden divs and animate y-axis from 100% to 0%.
motion.scroll_reveals: Use framer-motion whileInView to trigger subtle opacity and y-axis translations on scroll.
motion.hover_states: Images in bento grids scale up slightly (scale-105) on hover within an overflow-hidden container.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets WCAG AA standards. Red background with white text is valid. Grey backgrounds with black text is valid.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have a visible focus state. focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-red-600 focus-visible:ring-offset-2.
accessibility.aria: Include aria-labels for icon buttons and standard screen reader support.

media.image_treatment: Images should feel premium. Use aspect-video or aspect-[4/5] ratios. Wrap images in overflow-hidden containers.
media.client_logos: Filter logos to greyscale and apply hover color transition if possible, or keep purely greyscale for a sophisticated look.

hero.description: Large format printing machine cutting paper - dynamic hero.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required packages: yarn add framer-motion @studio-freight/lenis react-fast-marquee react-icons lucide-react
Use Cabinet Grotesk for headings and Inter for body text. Add them to index.html or layout wrapper.
Implement Lenis smooth scrolling globally in the App wrapper.
Build the hero with framer-motion line-by-line reveal using overflow-hidden wrappers around text lines.
Ensure the design remains industrial and sharp. Do not use soft border-radius (rounded-2xl is forbidden, use rounded-none).
Do not use generic centering. Emphasize grid alignments and negative space.
Client logos: Render the provided generic proxy images as small 120x60 grayscale object-contain images inside the Marquee.
Add sticky WhatsApp and Call floating action buttons using Lucide icons.
Create a SQLite DB based quote enquiry form via server actions or backend endpoints as part of the hybrid_fullstack setup.
Apply data-testid to all interactive elements.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
